meta.name: Magneta — DECOMMISSION PromotionPayment (Optimism)
meta.description: Neutralise the ghost PromotionPayment at 0x414dC3f0670227Ab3DDAd8B0A52aF7AdebC4a504 by zeroing every active duration code (1-6, currently priced 0.01 to 0.06 ETH), so pay() reverts with 'Unknown duration code' for everyone. Found by the 2026-08-01 free rescan: the contract was dropped from the manifests at the July redeploy wave (it survives only in optimism.json.pre-redeploy-bak) and the Terminal indexer no longer honours PromotionPaid events, yet payments were still live — a user could pay for a promotion that will never be displayed. The deployed bytecode is the PRE-pull-payment version (pay(address,uint8), no withdraw()/accumulatedFees()): it forwards value straight to feeRecipient, so nothing is stuck in the contract (native balance verified 0 on 2026-08-01). One transaction: setPricesBatch([1..6], [0×6]). Reversible at any time by the same owner with non-zero prices. Owner is this Safe; codes 7+ verified already 0.
